newsitem.title: USA: Limited Amtrak service resumes as N.J. fire burns.
newsitem.headline: Limited Amtrak service resumes as N.J. fire burns.

text.p: Limited train service has resumed in Amtrak's Northeast Corridor through New Brunswick, New Jersey, where firefighters are battling a fire in a Conrail Inc boxcar, a NJ Transit spokesman said.
He said rail service resumed at 1820 EDT/2220 GMT on tracks one and two -- two tracks of the four in the area farthest from the fire.
An Conrail spokesman said one boxcar loaded with lumber was burning.
The fire also disrupted Amtrak service between New York and Philadelphia -- and points south and west of there, including Washington, Amtrak spokesman Rick Remington said.
